caption: The drawing depicts a dress shown from the front, with a detailed color rendering and a line sketch of the bodice from the back view on the upper right side. The bodice of the dress is deep burgundy with long sleeves and has wide, ruffled trim in a lighter pink color along the neckline, shoulders, and cuffs. The neckline is deep and V-shaped, further accentuated by multiple ruffled layers. The skirt is floor-length, flowing, and cream or light beige in color, adorned with a pattern of green leafy vines with pink and yellow flowers distributed throughout. The back view sketch is done in pencil and outlines the same ruffled detailing on the bodice and sleeves without color. The drawing is on a plain, light-colored background with no additional objects present.
title: Dress
